title: Read the Status Codes
prompt:
Match each situation to its HTTP status code:

answers = { anonymousRun: "?", missingPage: "?", tooManyRequests: "?", allGood: "?" }

- anonymousRun: an anonymous user tries to execute code (the server refuses; not signed in)
- missingPage: the requested page does not exist
- tooManyRequests: the client exceeded the rate limit
- allGood: the request succeeded

tests.name: the four everyday codes
tests.hint: 401 · 404 · 429 · 200 — you have met every one of these on Code Journey itself.
